tableLines.line: 📓 Journal: the person in their 40s, with a nervous tic taught the person in their 60s, with a long braid Gossip Network.
📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
Snow by morning. Your breath comes out in ghosts.
📓 Codex: Addison taught Chloe Gossip Network.
✦ Hudson has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Chloe has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Naran has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Addison has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Ellis.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
You overhear it at the fire, and stop pretending not to listen. Riders from The Red Table are telling the deer story again — with your name attached this time.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Mei.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called The Red Table II. The region is bigger than your fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
📺 SYSTEM: ""You talk to EVERYONE and everyone talks to YOU?! You're not networking, you're COLLECTING people! The census bureau is jealous! KEEP COLLECTING!""
🧳 A traveler from northwest says The Red Table II is starving — Darius's been seen counting empty jars, and the kids have gone quiet.
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🥣 Darius of The Red Table II walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Darius waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table II with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🥣 Sam of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Sam waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Hank was killed — Tomás did it, they say. (The truth: dead is dead; the killing part is gossip.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Carlos speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🥣 Darius of The Red Table II walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Darius waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table II with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table II came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1000 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Thornfield and The Red Table have bound together — Thornfield primary. Other fires are climbing, too.
📓 Codex: Thornfield and The Red Table bound; Thornfield primary.

Darius waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table II with nothing. They'll remember the silence.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table II has bound itself to Thornfield. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
✦ Meera has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table II came in the night from the northwest. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

Darius waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table II with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
You accept Thornfield's food — 1,585 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Nadia clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Carlos's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 5 people, 107 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 19 plants — 15 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 6 people, 107 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 6 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the northwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

Fresh-cut stems on the northwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table II's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The northwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)

The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the northwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
